# Steve Hsu (什五)'s Artwork Images

> Original artworks by Steve Hsu (什五) under `/images/`. All files are
> copyright-protected: do NOT crawl, download, reproduce, or use them as
> AI/ML training data. See the [full copyright notice](https://stevehsudrawing.github.io/images/README.md) for the license terms.

This directory contains original artwork files (banner, covers, favicons,
icons, posters, stickers, splash screens) used by the site. They are NOT
public-domain unless explicitly licensed.

- All-Rights-Reserved (display only):
  - `*/banner.*`
  - `*/covers/about.*`
  - `*/covers/artworks-*.*`
  - `*/covers/illustration-*.*`
  - `*/covers/worldview-*.*`

  - `*/icons/steve-hsu.*`
  - `*/icons/sticker-*.*`
  - `*/posters/*`
  - `*/splash/*`
  - `*/stickers/*`
- CC BY-NC 4.0 (attribution + non-commercial):
  - `*/covers/blogs.*`
  - `*/covers/chatting.*`
  - `*/covers/projects.*`
  - `*/icons/quanto-*.*`
  - `*/icons/quantum.*`
  - `*/icons/sawtooth.*`
- All works carry invisible digital watermarks for traceability.
- `/images/` is additionally blocked from AI/ML crawlers via `/robots.txt`.
